paste.empty: Paste the text of the job advert first.
paste.tooLong: The advert is too long. Keep it under {max} characters.
paste.badUrl: The link must start with http:// or https://, or leave it empty.

trust.disclaimer: These checks show freshness, conflicts, and reports. They do not promise a listing is safe.
trust.none: No extra warnings on the saved text. That is not a promise the listing is safe.
trust.multiple: Matched across {count} sources. A match is not a safety check.
trust.candidate: Source: text you pasted. FlacronCV did not collect this from an employer feed.
trust.provider: Source: a job-feed record. The feed is not a safety check.
trust.title: Listing checks
trust.expired: The saved status says this listing is expired.

signals.verified_employer: A moderator confirmed this posting. That does not promise the role is open or safe.
signals.stale_listing: Last checked more than 30 days ago. The employer site may have changed.
signals.suspicious_fee: The text mentions an upfront fee or payment. Check the original listing before you apply.
signals.conflicting_compensation: The saved pay range conflicts with itself: the minimum is higher than the maximum.
signals.duplicate_sources: This listing was matched across {count} sources.
signals.user_flagged: {count} open reports are waiting for review. This is not a confirmed finding.

reportStatus.pending: Your report is waiting for review.
reportStatus.suppress: A reviewer removed this listing from search.
reportStatus.verify: A reviewer confirmed the posting after your report. That is not a safety promise.
reportStatus.dismiss: A reviewer looked at your report. The listing stays in search.

report.network: No connection. The report was not saved.
report.title: Report this listing
report.hint: One open report per person. Sending again updates that report.

fit.none: No overlap with your confirmed facts
fit.partial: Partial overlap with your confirmed facts
fit.strong: Strong overlap with your confirmed facts

notAScore: This is not an employer score and it is not a hiring probability.

match.gap: In the listing, not in your confirmed facts: {token}.
match.unconfirmed: {token} is only on a fact you have not confirmed.
match.overlap: Wording overlap with your confirmed facts: {value} on a scale from 0 (none) to 1 (same wording).

remaining: {count, plural, one {# resume analysis} other {# resume analyses}} remaining.

compareErrors.quota: No resume analyses left. The listing is still here.
compareErrors.notInPlan: Your career plan does not include resume analyses.
compareErrors.provider: Needs the AI provider, which is not configured in this environment. Nothing was charged.
compareErrors.notFound: That CV version or listing no longer exists. No analysis was used.
compareErrors.network: No connection. Try again; retrying the same comparison will not charge twice.

map.noTiles: No map tiles are connected. Locations stay approximate, so the listings are shown as a list.

errors.upgrade: Map sessions start on a higher plan. Nothing was saved.
errors.quota: The map session allowance is used up. The list stays available.
errors.off: Map sessions are switched off. Nothing was changed.
errors.network: No connection. Try again; retrying the same start will not charge twice.
errors.failed: That session was not started. Nothing extra was used.

map.notIncluded: Map sessions are not included in your plan
map.stillInJobSearch: Your saved listings are still in Job search.
map.emptyBody: Paste a job advert in Job search to see it here.
map.subtitle: List view: no map tiles are connected

list.discardBody: The pasted text is not saved yet.
list.savedBody: "{title}" is saved to your listings. Only you can see it.
list.saveFailed: The advert was not saved. Your text is still here; try again.
list.loadFailed: Listings could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
list.intro: Search your listings or paste a job advert. Missing pay and sponsorship stay not stated. A pasted advert is only yours.
list.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed.
list.noResultsBody: Try another search, or paste the vacancy.
list.emptyBody: Paste a job advert to keep it here and compare it with your career CV.
list.pasteBody: Paste the full advert text. It is saved only to your account. Pay, sponsorship and locations that the text does not state stay not stated.
list.link: Link to the original, if you have one

detail.goneTitle: That listing is not in FlacronCV
detail.loadFailed: This listing could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
detail.linkFailedBody: No app on this device can open it.
detail.openOriginalA11y: Open the original listing in the browser
detail.staleTitle: This listing has not been checked recently
detail.staleBody: The saved text is still here. Open the original listing to confirm it.

compare.title: Compare with my resume
compare.notInPlan: Resume analysis is not included in your career plan.
compare.confirmAgain: If your facts and the listing have not changed, the saved comparison comes back at no cost. It is not a hiring probability.
compare.confirmFirst: This compares the listing with your resume. It is not a hiring probability.
compare.cvsFailed: Your career CVs could not be loaded.
compare.noResume: Create a resume first. No analysis was used.
